_comment: Model registry. Edit this file to add / switch models — no code changes needed. 'labels' is either an inline array of class names (training order) or the name of a text asset with one label per line. 'decoded': false = raw DFL head (FeiGeChuanShu single-output YOLOv8), true = Ultralytics native `yolo export format=ncnn` (in0/out0, decode+sigmoid in graph). 'bgr': feed pixels as BGR (FeiGeChuanShu) or RGB (Ultralytics).
